Erythema Multiforme: F19: Standard phototesting with UV-A and UV-B: unremarkable
F2: Chief complaint: intensely pruritic skin eruption
F7: Erythema and helical thickening on both ears
F8: Numerous small blisters, 2 to 3 mm in diameter, on both ears
F9: Similar vesicles at the upper and lower vermillion border
